Contract CoCoMESystem::receiveOrderedProduct(orderID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		orderProd: OrderProduct = OrderProduct.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = orderID),
		entries: Set(OrderEntry) = orderProd.ContainedEntries
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		orderProd.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		result = false or
		orderProd.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		orderProd.OrderStatus = OrderStatus::RECEIVED and
		entries->forAll(e: OrderEntry|e.BelongedItem.StockNumber = e.BelongedItem.StockNumber@pre+e.Quantity) and
		result = true
}
